record.original_question: Which spaces occur as subspaces of extremally disconnected spaces? More specifically, does every compact basically disconnected space embed into an extremally disconnected space?

evidence.quote: Question 9. What are the subspaces of the extremally disconnected spaces? More speciﬁcally, does every compact basically disconnected space embed into an extremally disconnected space?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Hausdorff topological space X is called extremally disconnected if the closure of every open subset of X is open. It is called basically disconnected if the closure of every cozero-set (i.e., the complement of the zero-set of a continuous real-valued function) is open; equivalently, the closure of every open F_sigma-subset is open. Every extremally disconnected space is basically disconnected, and both classes are closed under passage to dense subspaces but not, in general, to arbitrary subspaces.

(a) Characterize the topological spaces that occur as (homeomorphic copies of) subspaces of extremally disconnected Hausdorff spaces.

(b) In particular, decide the following: does every compact Hausdorff basically disconnected space embed as a subspace of some extremally disconnected Hausdorff space?
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not produce a definitive resolution. Surveys on extremally disconnected spaces discuss subspace problems and note connections to Borel lifting problems for category algebras of generalized Cantor cubes, suggesting equivalence reformulations of the embedding question rather than a solution. No source clearly announces a positive or negative answer to whether every compact basically disconnected space embeds into an extremally disconnected space, so the status is taken as unknown / likely open.

status_evidence.title: A study of extremally disconnected topological spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing subspaces, retracts, and embedding properties of extremally disconnected spaces, including their relation to basically disconnected spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent survey treats embedding/subspace questions for extremally disconnected spaces without reporting a resolution of the compact basically disconnected embedding question.

status_evidence.title: Extremally disconnected spaces, subspaces and retracts
status_evidence.snippet: Studies which spaces appear as subspaces and retracts of extremally disconnected spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the problem of characterizing subspaces of extremally disconnected spaces is an active topic without a definitive characterization.
